scope: Local source review and fake-ROS tests only. This agent did not access keys, network, robot or installed service.

trigger.request: Stand up, wait one second, then stop.
trigger.observed: Live model called stand_up then immediate stop, had no declared wait tool, and narrated an unsupported ordering. Prior smoke is preserved unchanged.

findings.finding: Backend already has validated finite0<duration<=60 queued pause; it immediately returns acceptance and uses existing cancellation/safety checks.
HTTP queue/wait already exists, but the prior Gemini registry lacked any wait decorator.
Stop bypasses request serialization; it must not be converted to a delayed queue action.
DeskBackend settles every fake job after each tool call before returning acceptance. This illustrates outcomes but does not reproduce real web queue timing or same-batch cancellation.
Web returns each acceptance/result to Live; completed queue outcomes are not automatically pushed into that model context. robot_status exposes the latest queued outcome.

change: Add wait(duration) tool forwarding directly to existing Robot.wait. Existing backend bounds, current-mode retention and Stop timing are unchanged.
Description and prompt distinguish accepted queued pause from elapsed time, physical stillness, follower stopping or motor relaxation.
Prompt explicitly treats Stop as immediate even in a requested delayed-final-step sequence, refuses to promise that unsupported sequence, and forbids claiming cancelled actions completed.
No completion barrier, delayed Stop tool, new queue framework, RobotAPI, transport, web or registry changes.

coverage: Required numeric duration declaration and invalid types/bounds/nonfinite inputs
Acceptance precedes elapsed time and completion appears in status
Three actual queue submissions stand→wait→move without DeskBackend.settle between calls
Wait delays movement after full activation readiness
Immediate Stop clears queued pause and cancels current pause without waiting60s or holding request lock
Following/current controller remain unchanged during wait
tests.initial_test_adjustment: The first queue-order fixture requested0.1m/s, below the unchanged0.2m/s minimum. It was corrected to0.2m/s; the initial16pass/1failure log is preserved. No product limit was changed.

limitations: A queued wait tool does not make a subsequent immediate Stop run later. Timed-stop requests remain unsupported and must be reported honestly.
This source change cannot guarantee stochastic model compliance; root owns the new fake-only Live retest.
No model completion notifications or automatic polling were added. A latest outcome can be superseded by later work; no per-job completion subscription is claimed.
No new software has been staged onto the robot for this change.

independent_review.result: No material findings; all 17 new tests independently passed and 9 source, 4 log and original Live-trigger hashes matched.

wrap_up: User requested stop. No further live test or robot staging; these remain explicitly pending.
